fichas.title: High-Rise Buildings: Basics
fichas.summary: Defines high-rise buildings by the height of their uppermost occupied floor and describes block and tower typologies, typical uses, urban-location considerations, and approval requirements. Diagrams show floor-plan arrangements, a block-based layout, and a high-rise section with structural and level annotations.
uses: Public establishments on lower floors, including plazas and halls
